name: web-cms-template
description: Template Node.js de site institucional com CMS próprio baseado em blocos (React + Express + Prisma)

scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d || echo Docker indisponivel - seguindo sem subir Redis local, REDIS_URL externo sera usado se configurado
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm ci --include=dev --prefix server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client && npm test --prefix server
